original_acceptance: The minimum implementation consumes valid named inputs and meets the reviewed behavior cases; examples/templates alone do not establish completion.

Publish the specified baseline/metric results with denominators, measured/not-run state and limitations. A negative result may satisfy research acceptance if the protocol and artifact requirements are met.

asset_research_plan.decision: Generate a bounded batch of read-only collection intents using P07’s existing job ledger. Implement only asset eligibility and rate/concurrency policy; reuse existing retry, lease, cancellation and recovery state.
questions: Which batch/concurrency/time/traffic limits protect the chosen authorized lab/device classes?
How can incremental collection avoid repeatedly reading unchanged fields while respecting fresh-evidence needs?
How will offline assets, partial results, duplicate intents, retries and exhausted budgets appear without false success?
Which smallest implementation answers the declared project need, and what evidence would make the extension unnecessary?
asset_research_plan.comparison: Start with the existing bounded serial worker. Compare only after measuring a real bottleneck; keep simulated planning load separate from measured lab collection.
cases: One slot remains under the concurrency limit — Existing active work consumes capacity; intent preparation must respect it.
The semantic intent already exists — Reuse the existing ledger identity instead of creating another retry/recovery engine.
Campaign cancelled before preparation — Cancellation blocks new intent generation; ledger/runner owners govern already-running attempts.
consumers: C22: campaign constraints, replay/failure outcomes and measured collection cost.
P07/P08: collection intents through the existing durable-job and runner trust contracts.
Shams’s asset operators: pause/resume/unknown-state evidence without a second queue.
asset_research_plan.reviewers: Omar checks ledger/envelope reuse; Amr reviews authorized lab load assumptions without taking collection ownership.
asset_research_plan.start: Activate when a measured multi-asset baseline violates an agreed time/resource/operator-effort target. A small lab that works with existing serial dispatch does not justify a new orchestration subsystem. C20 is optional, not a prerequisite.
